statement: The State of Tennessee carries out the scheduled execution of Christa Pike between 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-02.
resolution: TRUE if the Tennessee Department of Correction, or AP or Reuters citing it, confirms Pike was executed on a date between 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-02; FALSE on clemency, stay, reprieve, or postponement past 2026-10-02.
failure_condition: Christa Pike is alive at the end of 2026-10-02 because of clemency, a court stay, a reprieve, or a rescheduled date.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
